The '''''Celestine''''' was a droid legend&mdash;a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-[[Droid/Legends|droid]] hybrid. It was a large [[Warship/Legends|warship]] designed to be operated only by droids. It was equipped with one of the largest and most highly advanced [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brains]] of its era. After departing the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] where it was built, with a great deal of bravado, the ship jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], but never arrived at its programmed destination.

===Legend===
There was no official record of the ''Celestine'' ever being commissioned, yet its legend was perpetuated in stories told by [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who claimed to have seen it jumping to lightspeed. Some even boasted to have seen the vessel while they themselves were traveling through hyperspace. It was believed that seeing the warship in the midst of battle was a bad omen.
